title: SvgFeMorphology
responsibility: Renders the native feMorphology element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeMorphology.attributes
inputs.description: Native feMorphology attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeMorphology.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feMorphology element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeMorphology
outputs.description: The actual native feMorphology element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
